figurative_meaning_en: to come close; to approach closely
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার সাথে ধরাছোঁয়া করো না, সে বিপজ্জনক।
example_sentences_in_english: Don't get too close to him, he's dangerous.
The friends were chatting in close proximity.
note: This idiom often implies physical or social closeness, sometimes with a cautionary tone.
